decisions.title: Three Seams, Not a New Architecture
decisions.description: The capstone composes representatives onto the s01 loop: tools in the registry, layers around dispatch (approval then sandbox in real Codex; this file lets sandbox speak first), and withMemory around the model call. It does not invent a Teams/Cron/Worktree router.
decisions.alternatives: Glue all 19 demos into one file. That would hide the seams and blow past the line budget.

zh.title: 三类接缝，不是新架构
zh.description: 终点章把代表机制套回 s01 循环：注册表里的工具、包住 dispatch 的层（真实 Codex 先审批再进沙箱；本文件让沙箱先说话）、以及包住模型调用的 withMemory。它不发明 Teams/Cron/Worktree 路由器。

decisions.title: MCP Is Registered Before the Loop
decisions.description: registerMcp("docs") runs in main() and exposes mcp__docs__search. That matches Codex starting MCP from config at session start. The server here is an in-process mock; s19 showed real stdio. The model has no connect_mcp tool.
decisions.alternatives: Expose connect_mcp as a function tool. That invents an API Codex does not have.

zh.title: MCP 在循环开始前注册
zh.description: main() 里 registerMcp("docs")，暴露 mcp__docs__search。这对应 Codex 在会话启动时按 config 拉起 MCP。本章是进程内 mock；真 stdio 是 s19。模型没有 connect_mcp 工具。

decisions.title: Representatives, Not an Encyclopedia
decisions.description: spawn_subagent is s06's fresh-context child, not s15's mailbox. Skills, compact, AGENTS.md, the task board, teams, and worktrees still hang on these seams; this chapter does not restack them. Part II starts at s21.
decisions.alternatives: Re-run s12–s18 inside the capstone. That re-teaches collab isolation and hides that the loop never changed.

zh.title: 代表机制，不是百科全书
zh.description: spawn_subagent 是 s06 的干净上下文子循环，不是 s15 的信箱。技能、压缩、AGENTS.md、任务板、团队、worktree 仍挂在这些接缝上，本章不重跑。Part II 从 s21 开始。
